note: Wolf's Garage post queue - Build #1 Station 3/4 contract. Written by the post-assembler skill, read by the Approval Queue page (Build 1.2) and the publisher (Build 1.3). Statuses: pending_approval -> approved | killed | fix -> published. Nothing publishes without John's tap. Schema v2 (2026-07-03): photo slides carry source_file + crop {focus_x, focus_y, zoom} so the approval page can re-crop and re-render in-browser. Schema v3 (2026-08-02): each draft carries an "aspect" (portrait 1080x1350 | landscape 1080x566 | square 1080x1080) and a "frame" (pinstripe | thin | none). A carousel is single-aspect because Instagram forces it. Drafts with no aspect/frame field are portrait/pinstripe, which is what they were rendered as. Renders come from the full-resolution ORIGINAL via the media index, never from the renders/posts/_sources copies, and assemble.py aborts rather than upscale. FRAME STANDARD (John's call 2026-08-02): new drafts render "thin" (12px). The 43px "pinstripe" frame is RETIRED and stays only on already-published history. CLOSER (same call): every caption ends "Get back in the garage." - the earlier rotation rule is dead.
